author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
Today we’re talking about animals. Specifically… the deeply strange things they’ve been up to while you’ve been busy being normal.

From criminal slugs and robber bees, to cows with zebra stripes and sharks dealing with some real career adversity, this is another It’s Wild Out There where we look at the weirdest animal news stories on Earth and Ryan-George-ify them.

Nature is beautiful.
Nature is powerful.
Nature is also extremely confusing right now.

Subscribe for more very serious journalism like this.
